data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 3101, commit 8fe6c1c358b (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, no advisories). The ticket's named test was already deleted by 3beb7e4ad23; the surviving assertion at tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py moved into its own test, test_copied_opcert_signing_keys_are_owner_only, guarded by observed chmod behaviour. Scratch-copy checks: probe forced false gives 1 skipped with the reason; a key widened to 0o666 with a working probe fails. make verify locally: only the 17 known pandoc failures under tests/unit/reconciler; Linux CI green. The Windows ACL question is tracked in 47d8-baf8-2348-45c9.
